###############################################################################
# Power Without War: producer cartel decisions
# (GENERATED by tools/pww_cartel_gen.py; do not edit by hand)
#
# Per resource: call a producers' conference, join, leave, court a member
# away (poach), lean on a member (importers), flood the market (producers
# outside the cartel). Human only (AI cartel play is scripted in
# pww_cartel_*.txt). Effects take temp inputs; see pww_cartel_core.txt.
###############################################################################

pww_cartel_category = {

	pww_cartel_call_aluminium = {
		icon = generic_industry
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 30
		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			has_country_flag = pww_cartel_glut_aluminium
			check_variable = { global.pww_cart_by_res^1 = -1 }
		}
		available = {
			OR = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cartel_standing } check_variable = { pww_cartel_standing > 29.999 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.pww_cart_cd_res^1 > global.num_days } }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = pww_cartel_call_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { pww_in_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_in_leader = ROOT }
				pww_cartel_open_conference = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

	pww_cartel_join_aluminium = {
		icon = generic_industry
		cost = 10
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 30
		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			check_variable = { global.pww_cart_by_res^1 > -1 }
			pww_core_produces_aluminium = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = pww_cartel_mem_aluminium }
		}
		available = {
			OR = { NOT = { has_variable = pww_cartel_standing } check_variable = { pww_cartel_standing > 29.999 } }
			has_war = no
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = pww_cartel_join_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { pww_in_cartel_id = global.pww_cart_by_res^1 }
				set_temp_variable = { pww_in_country = ROOT }
				pww_cartel_join = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

	pww_cartel_leave_aluminium = {
		icon = generic_industry
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 30
		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			has_country_flag = pww_cartel_mem_aluminium
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = pww_cartel_leave_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { pww_in_res = 1 }
				pww_cartel_find_member = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { pww_out_cm > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_cm = pww_out_cm }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_cause = 0 }
					pww_cartel_leave = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

	pww_cartel_poach_aluminium = {
		icon = generic_industry
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 60
		visible = {
			is_ai = no
			check_variable = { global.pww_cart_by_res^1 > -1 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = pww_cartel_mem_aluminium }
		}
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				has_country_flag = pww_cartel_mem_aluminium
				is_ai = yes
			}
		}
		available = {
			num_of_available_civilian_factories > 0
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = pww_cartel_poach_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_res = 1 }
					pww_cartel_find_member = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { pww_out_cm > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_cm = pww_out_cm }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_tempter = ROOT }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_premium = 0 }
					pww_cartel_tempt = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }

			custom_effect_tooltip = pww_cartel_press_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_res = 4 }
					pww_cartel_find_member = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { pww_out_cm > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_cm = pww_out_cm }
					set_temp_variable = { pww_in_presser = ROOT }
					pww_cartel_press = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}
